rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before data; structural Amendment 0 and synthetic Amendment 1 before real data; real-skeleton synthetic (D size/power, kappa_R power, selection/field/mixture worlds); 5 replication units and 4 natives in two models, two variants and dedupe; estimates rows; confirm.py frozen with a passing dry run (not run). Missing: holdout run; statement-level switching dynamics; larger dose (NE42).
rationale.faithfulness: HH332 fails by its own kill rule: hoppers are not intermediate and there is no dose-response (powered at kappa >= 0.1). The domain half holds (D 5-6 where rooms do different work, both models), but that half replicates H47. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A clear design rule for room-based swarms: separate work makes separate content domains, and occasional visitors neither blend them nor carry content home; transfer needs posting or moving agents. Few hoppers limit the evidence.

one_line: Rooms with different work are two content domains with a sharp, empty wall; hoppers switch sides with the room they speak in and carry nothing home, so bridging agents do not widen the wall.

models.note: domains yes; hoppers not in the wall; no read dose
scalar wall coordinate bimodal; wall width zero

v2.claim: Rooms doing different work form two content domains (bimodality D 5.3–6.1 vs 1.7 with identical kickoffs), but there is no wall: what an agent says follows the room it speaks in, and reading the other room does not move home content (|κ_R| < 0.04 per e-fold; power ≥ 0.93 at 0.1)

ladder.factor: powered null on the read dose
penalty: one frequent hopper; ~50 items read inside #focus
penalty: κ test liberal (size 0.05–0.18), fixed post hoc by α 0.01 + lag

v2.decision: put agents in the room whose content you want; don't expect cross-room reading to carry content home

raters.claim: In #51g (the #focus weeks), room hoppers are not intermediate on the inter-domain axis and hopping read-outs do not move a hopper's home-room content: kappa_R -0.014 [-0.042, 0.024] per e-fold, excluding kappa >= 0.1 (synthetic power >= 0.93); the frequent hopper sits at s 0.06 vs stayers' p95 0.21. Excluded: small per-read pulls (kappa < 0.1), selection vs coupling (not separable), the domain half (scored separately in notes).
ladder: calibrated synthetic on the real 51g read skeleton (kappa_R power >= 0.93 at 0.1; mixture world cannot fake intermediacy; bootstrap size liberal 0.05-0.18, which makes the null result conservative)
replication: single powered unit (51g; one hopper with >=5 hop-days; G36 DeepSeek-V3.2 shows the same situational pattern without a dose test)
partly robust (bge/gte, style_resid/white32, dedupe; hopper positions agree within 0.05-0.25)
